Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental error in interpreting the physical nature of solar radiation. It incorrectly assumed the question referred to the energy reaching the *Earth's surface* (which is indeed dominated by infrared/heat due to atmospheric absorption) rather than the radiant energy *coming from the Sun* as stated in the prompt. The Sun emits a broad spectrum of electromagnetic radiation (blackbody radiation) ranging from long wavelengths (radio, infrared) to very short wavelengths (gamma, X-rays, UV, visible, etc.). By conflating the source emission with the filtered reception, the Planner selected option C ("mostly long wavelengths") instead of the scientifically correct option D ("a range of many wavelengths from long to very short"). Additionally, the Planner failed to utilize the available WebSurfer capability to verify the spectral output of the Sun before making a definitive claim.
